name: Elastic
description: Elastic is the company behind Elasticsearch, a distributed RESTful search and analytics engine, offering unified solutions for AI-powered search, observability, and security built on the same data platform.
best_for: Organizations seeking unified solutions for search, monitoring, and threat detection, trusted by 50% of the Fortune 500 across financial services, manufacturing, retail, and telecommunications.
features: Elasticsearch: a distributed, RESTful search and analytics engine
Vector database functionality for storing and searching embeddings
Observability: log analytics, infrastructure monitoring, and application performance monitoring (APM)
AIOps with automatic issue detection and resolution using generative AI
AI-driven SIEM for security threat detection and investigation
XDR and endpoint security with AI-driven insights and automated alert triage
Flexible deployment: Elastic Cloud Serverless, Elastic Cloud Hosted, or self-managed

alternatives.name: Algolia
alternatives.description: An AI-powered search and discovery API platform for search, recommendations, and personalization.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a fully managed, developer-friendly search API rather than operating a search cluster.

alternatives.name: Supabase
alternatives.description: An open-source backend platform built on Postgres, with built-in full-text search alongside database, auth, and storage APIs.
alternatives.best_for: Developers wanting lightweight search built into their existing backend rather than a dedicated search/observability platform.

pricing.starting_price: Elastic Cloud Hosted Standard starts as low as $99/month; Serverless is usage-based and self-managed licensing is separate

tiers.name: Cloud Hosted Standard
tiers.notes: Starts as low as $99/month; actual cost depends on cloud provider, region, deployment size, storage, and resource choices.

tiers.name: Cloud Hosted Gold
tiers.notes: Starts as low as $114/month with additional reporting, alerting, and monitoring capabilities.

tiers.name: Cloud Hosted Enterprise
tiers.notes: Starts as low as $184/month; adds higher-end search, AI, support, and platform capabilities.

tiers.name: Serverless
tiers.notes: Usage-based pricing rather than a fixed monthly subscription.

tiers.name: Self-managed
tiers.notes: License-based pricing; separate from Elastic Cloud Hosted pricing.

cons: Elastic Cloud Hosted prices are 'as low as' starting points rather than fixed quotes; actual cost changes with cloud provider, region, deployment resources, storage, and usage.
Elastic's Hosted, Serverless, and self-managed offerings use different billing models, so prices from one deployment model are not directly interchangeable with another.
Higher support levels and some advanced capabilities are tied to higher subscription levels rather than Standard.
